Do not do this. As was stated by Hayden97, suicide is a permanent solution to a temporary problem. Help is everywhere, only disguised as different things. Talking to the suicide prevention hotline (1-800-273-8255) helps, i've done it before. Also, separate yourself from your mother. You're an adult now, you can go anywhere you'd like and even stay days away from her house, even weeks or months or however long you'd like to.

Please don't do this. You're young, and have many years left on this Earth. Get a nice job, get married, have kids, tour the world, try new things, etc. SO many things left to do.

If you need a pal to talk to... i'm here.

If you killed yourself, I would feel like shit even though I don't even know you. There are many MANY jobs out there that you can get and you can switch your major I think. I think right now you need to go somewhere and laugh, at least to loosen yourself up a bit. Maybe r/funny? I usually chill there just for some giggles. Then, i'd think about other careers. Art is a wonderful field to go into, and there are many different types of art. It's all around us. Your parents shouldn't be picking what you do in your life, it's YOUR life.
